t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Scroll
d: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, she is desperate to improve her abilities.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Jet
d: While traveling towards the North Pole, the group almost gets captured by the Fire Nation.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Great Divide
d: When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Storm
d: A powerful storm brings up painful memories of the past - and puts everyone in jeopardy in the present.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Blue Spirit
d: After Sokka and Katara get sick due to being in the storm, Aang seeks out a cure and discovers he needs some frozen frogs in order to get them cured.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Fortuneteller
d: Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives - but they are so reliant that they are blind to the immanent danger they are all in.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bato of the Water Tribe
d: Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Deserter
d: Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Northern Air Temple
d: After hearing rumors about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Master
d: The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Meanwhile, Zhao plans an attack and Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North Part 1
st: The Siege of the North Part 1
d: The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao's Fire Navy fleet. In the heat of battle, Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn't a better way to use his Avatar abilities.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North Part 2
st: The Siege of the North Part 2
d: Zhao's invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe's defenses, and he reveals a sinister plan.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar State
d: Aang and the group meet an Earth Kingdom general who wants to use Aang's powerful "Avatar State" as a weapon to defeat the Fire Nation. But getting into the "Avatar state" on purpose is more difficult than Aang thinks.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Cave of Two Lovers
d: On their way to Omashu, the kids meet a group of nomads who show them a short cut through the 'cave of two lovers'.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Return to Omashu
d: The kids return to Omashu so that Aang can learn Earthbending from King Bumi. But when they get there, they are shocked to find the city is now in Fire Nation hands. Despite the danger, Aang enters Omashu in search of King Bumi.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Swamp
d: When the kids end up in a mysterious and strange swamp, their fears are exposed. And Aang learns about being "connected to the Earth" from an unlikely teacher.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Avatar Day
d: Aang must clear up a wave of anti-Avatar sentiment and atone for something he did in the past.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Blind Bandit
d: In search for an Earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground Earthbending tournament where they encounter Toph, a blind, but powerful Earthbender.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Zuko Alone
d: Traveling without Uncle now, Zuko wanders alone into an Earth Kingdom town where he bonds with a local boy. Meanwhile, Zuko is haunted by memories of his own youth.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender
d: As the kids are pursued relentlessly by a mysterious machine, their exhaustion puts them at each other's throats.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bitter Work
d: When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher. Meanwhile, Sokka gets himself in a jam.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Library
d: A professor leads the kids to a spirit library in the middle of the desert, where Sokka hopes to discover powerful secrets to use against the Fire Nation.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Desert
d: Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Uncle and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Serpent's Pass
d: The group then huddles around the map to discuss in which direction they should go - the Serpent's Pass appears to be the most direct route.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Drill
d: Aang discovers a secret Fire Nation super weapon heading straight for Ba Sing Se and must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: City of Walls and Secrets
d: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them. Meanwhile, Jet tries to find proof that Zuko and Uncle are Fire Nation.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Tales of Ba Sing Se
d: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Uncle, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Appa's Lost Days
d: In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen, and find out exactly what happened to him, and where's he's been all this time - and where he is now!

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Lake Laogai
d: While searching for Appa, the kids run into Jet, but are torn about whether to trust him or not. Meanwhile, Zuko also hunts for Appa.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Earth King
d: The kids battle Long Feng the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Guru
d: Aang starts to learn control of the Avatar State from Guru Pathik at the Eastern Air Temple. Sokka is reunited with his father.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Crossroads of Destiny
d: When Aang has a vision that Katara is in danger, Aang, Sokka, and Toph all rush back to Ba Sing Se to save her. They meet up with Iroh, who asks their help in saving Zuko who had been captured as well.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Awakening
d: After sustaining serious injuries at the end of season two, Aang awakens to find himself aboard a Fire Nation ship. Meanwhile, Zuko journeys home.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Headband
d: Mistaken for a Fire Nation School student, the disguised Aang is forced to enroll in a Fire nation school. Aang's hair helped to disguise him better with his head band.

t: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Painted Lady
d: When the gang comes to a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.
